span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Peer assisted learning does not reach performance directly; it first raises students' interest in mathematics, and that interest is what raises performance
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Interest is a necessary link in the chain: peer learning that fails to build interest produces no performance gain at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The study analysed only the higher-order constructs of teaching quality and learning interest, not their first-order sub-dimensions, which might have yielded different results.
span.note: what this limits: the level at which the finding holds: THIS STUDY HOWEVER FOCUSED ON THE HIGHER-ORDER VARIABLES (TEACHING QUALITY AND LEARNING INTEREST), WITHOUT SPECIFIC ATTENTION ON THE FIRST-ORDER VARIABLES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Attending to the first-order variables is left to future research.
span.note: what this limits: the treatment of the first-order variables: FOCUSING SPECIFIC ATTENTION ON THE FIRST-ORDER VARIABLES MAY HAVE PROVIDED [a] DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE TO THE RESULTS ATTAINED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Measurement items were deleted by a stipulated loading threshold, so the constructs analysed are not the constructs as originally specified.
span.note: what this limits: the constructs in this model as the ones the instrument was designed to measure: items loading below 0.5 were deleted during the confirmatory factor analysis
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only the higher-order variables were analysed; the authors state the first-order dimensions were not examined and might have given a different picture.
span.note: what this limits: conclusions about teaching quality or learning interest as such: only the higher-order variables were analysed, and the authors state the first-order dimensions might have given a different perspective
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The sample is non-random and drawn from a single campus, while the framing concerns mathematics performance across the region.
span.note: what this limits: generalising these results beyond the studied group: the 373 first-year undergraduates were selected by purposive and convenience sampling on one campus
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THREE OF THE FIVE CONSTRUCTS FALL BELOW THE CONVENTIONAL 0.7 RELIABILITY THRESHOLD and the paper reports the figures without comment: motivation 0.655, mathematics learning 0.597, interest 0.667, against teaching quality 0.701 and performance 0.704. The two mediation results the paper turns on rest on the interest scale at 0.667.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Seven measurement items were deleted after the fact for loading below 0.5 - two each from motivation and peer assisted learning, three from teaching quality - so the constructs analysed are not the constructs the instrument was designed to measure, and the deletion is reported per construct rather than justified.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the Fornell and Larcker thresholds applied - average variance extracted at least 0.5 and composite reliability at least 0.7 - before the constructs are used
span.note: eliminates: constructs that do not measure a single thing, or measure it unreliably, being carried into the structural model as if they did

span.label: contradicts → prior peer-tutoring findings that peer assisted learning directly determines mathematics performance (Thurston et al., 2020; Rockinson-Szapkiw & Wendt, 2020; Alegre et al., 2019)

span.label: peer assisted learning —causes→ mathematics learning interest
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — FULL MEDIATION, which is a claim that a DIRECT path is absent: peer assisted learning reaches performance only through interest. The paper's contribution is the removal of an edge other studies drew, not the addition of one.

span.label: mathematics learning motivation —causes→ performance in mathematics
span.note: differs in: PARTIAL AGAINST FULL MEDIATION - motivation keeps a direct path to performance alongside the one through interest, where peer assisted learning keeps none. Same mediator, same outcome, and the difference is whether the direct effect survives · strength of the relation: 0.8
